name: screen
description: See the real desktop and move the mouse and keyboard. This is the whole screen, not a web page. Call screen_shot first. You can see that picture. x and y are pixels from the top-left. screen_click clicks there. screen_cursor_move_human moves the mouse along a curved path with pauses, like a person — use it before a captcha click or when a site watches the cursor. screen_type types text into the window that has focus. screen_key presses one key, such as Return or ctrl+c. Do not guess coordinates. Look at the picture first.
examples: root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|what is on the screen -> discover(path='mcp/screen', enable=true); screen_shot()
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|click the button at the bottom right -> screen_shot(); screen_click(x=900, y=700)
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|move the mouse like a person to the checkbox -> screen_cursor_move_human(x=420, y=310)
root|console|<issued>|<delivered>|type hello and press enter -> screen_type(text='hello'); screen_key(key='Return')
